notes.title: Update: Spooky Forest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252836/c89a3684cf0216baa8e75a1b1d35aa033c880326.png[/img]

[h1][u][b]The roadmap has been worked off![/b][/u][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252836/51b3e9c462b838e7ece5d6ef89cef05f8cb9e921.png[/img]
[h2]
There are new [b]enemies[/b]!
A new [b]boss[/b]!
And a new [b]map[/b]![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252836/a324db78705bc3a7c8580432cdb6771dd88cb468.png[/img]

[h3]In addition, Binda now has skins for you and of course the story of our 2 heroes and the duckling continues![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252836/2439af0109612400bc6b6cd0f3fe1d6af20b86cf.gif[/img]
[u][b][h3]
I wish everyone a lot of fun with the update![/h3][/b][/u]
